_comment: Hooks scoped to the e2e suite. Used when a session is opened with e2e/ as the project root. When the repo root is the project root, the same SessionStart entry lives in the root .claude/settings.json, pointing at e2e/.agents/hooks/. The PY= prefix picks an interpreter that actually runs: on Windows a bare `python3` resolves to the Microsoft Store alias stub, which exits 49 and makes the hook silently do nothing.
